question_en: After service on an exit or emergency lighting system, what evidence should be documented?
options: Test results and verification of operation against applicable requirements.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: C-20.02 requires testing, verification and documentation of operational problems and test results.
explanation_es: C-20.02 exige pruebas, verificación y documentación de problemas y resultados.

question_en: A cathodic-protection reading is abnormal after component service. What should occur before the job is closed?
options: Test the system, verify operation against applicable requirements and document the results.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: C-21.02 requires testing after service and documentation of operational problems and test results.
explanation_es: C-21.02 exige pruebas después del servicio y documentación de problemas y resultados.

question_en: What objective is identified when maintaining continuity of cathodic protection during service work?
options: Maintain continuity of the protection system while the required service is completed.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: C-21.02 identifies maintaining continuity of cathodic protection during service where required.
explanation_es: C-21.02 identifica mantener la continuidad de la protección catódica durante el servicio cuando se requiera.
